title: sagraea setulosa
intro: Sagraea setulosa, commonly known as "hairy sagraea," is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Sagraea setulosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Sagraea setulosa may also include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and potential anti-cancer properties.
